source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Deployment phase (PDF 9-10).

blocks.text: Jab software achi tarah test ho jaye aur masle theek ho jayein to woh deployment phase mein jata hai. Deployment ka matlab hai software ko users ke liye available (istemal ke liye tayyar) karna ta ke woh use istemal kar sakein. Is mein aksar kai steps hote hain:

items: Installation: software user ke system ya server par install kiya jata hai. Is mein aksar ek installation program chalaya jata hai jo files copy karta hai aur zaroori settings (configurations) set karta hai.
Configuration: software ko user ya organization ki khaas zarooraton ke mutabiq set kiya jata hai, jaise user ki pasand (preferences), network settings aur database connections.

Testing in the Real World: install hone ke baad software ko us ke real-world environment (asal jagah jahan woh chalega) mein test kiya jata hai ta ke woh doosre systems ke saath theek chale aur users ki zarooratein poori kare.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Software deploy karna nayi dukaan kholne jaisa hai. Jab sab kuch tayyar ho jaye to aap customers (users) ko apna product istemal karne ke liye bulate hain.

blocks.prompt: Deployment mein install karne ke baad software dobara test kyun kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke asal mahol development wale mahol se mukhtalif hota hai. Check karna zaroori hai ke software user ke doosre systems, settings aur data ke saath theek chale aur asal mein users ki zarooratein poori kare.

items: Deployment: test kiya hua software users ke liye available karna.
Steps: installation, configuration, real world mein testing (nayi dukaan kholne jaisa).
